mapper.select: select DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID from scc_sc_order o JOIN scc_sc_order_detail d on d.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID where ((o.ORDER_STATUS IN ('APPROVED') and IFNULL(o.EXT_STATUS,'') = '') or o.EXT_STATUS IN ('ONGOING')) and o.VENDOR_ID=#{vendorId} and d.ORDER_NUM > d.DELIVERY_NOTICE_QUANTITY and o.EXT_ORDER_PROPERTY != 'SERVICE'
